description: Erection of single storey front extension and single storey rear extension with alterations to the original house, expansion of the front garden with replacement boundary treatments and re-siting of the single car parking bay.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  4D-239A E00 (Rev A); 4D-239A E01; 4D-239A E02; 4D-239A E03; 4D-239A E04; 4D-239A E05; 4D-239A E06; 4D-239A E07; 4D-239A E08; 4D-239A P01 (Rev A); 4D-239A P02 (Rev A); 4D-239A P03 (Rev A); 4D-239A P04 (Rev A); 4D-239A P05; 4D-239A P06; 4D-239A P07 (Rev A); 4D-239A P08 (Rev A)  Received:  24 July 2023;  4D-239 P01A (Rev A)  Received:  30 May 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey front and rear extensions hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Prior to completion of development, the existing side vehicular access to the existing front garage shall be removed to facilitate the expansion of the house's front garden with replacement boundary treatments as hereby approved.  

No replacement front or side vehicular access to the existing garage from the private highway The Marais shall be established without the approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The replacement front boundary treatments adjoining the private highway The Marais and replacement front car parking bay shall be timber fences and permanently not exceed a height of two metres.
